questions.question: A solid conducting sphere has a net negative charge − Q . Which of the following correctly indicates how the excess charge is distributed, and provides a valid justification?

options.text: The excess charge is distributed on the surface of the sphere, because negatively charged particles’ mutual repulsion causes them to move to the surface.

The net charge is distributed uniformly throughout the sphere, because negatively charged particles added to the sphere will arrange themselves in the configuration with the highest degree of symmetry.
